design.backgroundPool: Within each field, all top-10 anchors excluded before drawing five independent four-member backgrounds; no response-based selection
analysis: Within each background sample variance across ten anchors; mean over backgrounds
Within each anchor sample variance across five backgrounds; mean over anchors
Balanced two-way additive decomposition: row/column/interaction sums of squares; degrees-of-freedom corrected mean squares
Leave-one-background and leave-one-anchor sensitivity; no population significance claim
Rank correlation against original personal score; previous observations reused only descriptively
A/B preference only if conditional variance and decomposition and sensitivity agree; C when both factors change outcomes and dominance is not clear; D if limited design prevents diagnosis
design.limits: One ownership set and same ten map seeds. No repeated independent worlds per cell, so interaction and finite-map noise cannot be separated. Different top-10 exclusions slightly restrict backgrounds relative to prior independent 30 teams.
